description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of scores across ten distinct relational association categories evaluated in the MMRA benchmark for large visual language models. The chart is divided into ten colored slices, each labeled with the category name, its corresponding score, and its percentage contribution to the total. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the categories and their approximate proportions are: NearSameEntity (63, 6.34%, dark gray), RelativePosition (81, 7.90%, light gray), MentalitySimilarity (89, 8.67%, light cyan), SimilarEvent (90, 8.77%, light blue), AppearanceSimilarity (90, 8.77%, light green), Layout (90, 8.77%, light yellow), Environment (90, 8.77%, dark green), UsageSimilarity (100, 9.65%, reddish-brown), SubEvent (100, 9.74%, red), and SimilarMaterial (106, 10.33%, orange). The largest segment is ObservationAngle (126, 12.28%, light teal). Each slice contains its label and percentage value, and there is no legend or exploded segments; the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top left.
